description: Return the GLEIF Level 2 "who owns whom" data for an LEI: direct accounting-consolidation parent and ultimate parent (with names, relationship status, periods and corroboration), or the reporting exception explaining why a parent is not reported (e.g. NON_CONSOLIDATING, NATURAL_PERSONS), plus the number of direct children. Useful for KYB / UBO pre-checks at company level.
name: gleif_ownership_chain
